title: Maruti Suzuki Launches India's 1st Flex-Fuel Car 'Wagon R' (E20 to E100)
summary: Hero MotoCorp also launches flex-fuel Splendor Plus and HF Deluxe motorcycles.

blocks.content: Hero MotoCorp also launches flex-fuel Splendor Plus and HF Deluxe motorcycles.

items: Flex-Fuel Debut: Maruti Suzuki Wagon R flex-fuel runs on any blend of ethanol and petrol from E20 to E100.
Target Dispenser Rollout: Government aims to deploy 5,000 E85 fuel dispensers by end of 2027.
Blending Milestone: India reached 20% ethanol blending (E20) threshold in mid-2025, 5 years ahead of target.
